title: The Monster Squad
tagline: Never send a man to do a kid's job.
about: A club of monster-mad kids gets Van Helsing's diary and has until midnight to send Dracula and his monsters into limbo.
cue: Serve the subs when Horace kicks the Wolf Man in the nards.
faces: to eat, laugh and watch a film at

WOLF MAN MEATBALL SUBS WITH PROVOLONE

Roast garlic butter and three melting cheeses.How to make it1 whole garlic bulb2 tbsp olive oil2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed60g butter, softened3 tbsp tomato paste1 tsp dried oregano150g mozzarella, grated40g parmesan, finely grated1/2 cup flat-leaf parsley, choppedCut the top off the garlic bulb, drizzle with oil, wrap in foil and roast at 200°C until soft.Squeeze the garlic out and mash it with the butter and parsley.Spread each pastry sheet with tomato paste, then the garlic butter, oregano and cheeses.Roll up tightly, cut into 2cm rounds and lay them flat on a lined tray.Bake at 200°C until puffed, golden and bubbling.Black Lagoon fish bites with tartareGill-man down. My name is Horace. Crisp flathead with tartare and lemon.How to make it500g flathead fillets, cut in bite-size pieces75g plain flour2 eggs120g panko breadcrumbs250ml vegetable oil, for frying125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp capers, chopped2 tbsp gherkins, chopped1 lemonStir the mayonnaise, capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon into a tartare.Dip the fish in seasoned flour, beaten egg, then panko.Shallow-fry in batches in hot oil until golden and just cooked.Drain and serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.Garlic butter knots at the doorVampires wait outside.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main CourseWolf Man meatball subs with provoloneWolf Man's got nards. Beef meatballs in red sauce under provolone.How to make it600g beef mince1 egg40g dried breadcrumbs30g parmesan, finely grated3 garlic cloves, crushed1 brown onion, diced2 tbsp olive oil700g bottle tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano4 long soft sub rolls8 slices of provolone1/2 cup basil leavesMix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and half the garlic, then roll into 16 balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil and lift them out.Soften the onion and the rest of the garlic, add the passata and oregano, return the meatballs and simmer until cooked through.Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, lay over the provolone and grill until melted.Tear over the basil and serve.Scary German Guy's bratwurst and krautHe translates Van Helsing's diary. Grilled bratwurst with kraut and hot mustard.How to make it8 pork bratwursts1 brown onion, sliced20g butter500g jar sauerkraut, drained1 tsp caraway seeds8 crusty bread rolls4 tbsp hot German mustardCook the onion slowly in the butter until soft, then add the sauerkraut and caraway and warm through.Grill the bratwurst over medium heat, turning, until browned and cooked through.Split the rolls, add the kraut and bratwurst and finish with mustard.DessertLast-chance-for-more apple pie with creamScary German Guy serves the boys pie. Cinnamon apple pie with thick cream.How to make it2 sheets of frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed6 granny smith apples, peeled and sliced100g caster sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon1 tbsp cornflour1 lemon, juiced30g butter1 egg, beaten300ml thick creamCook the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice and butter until just tender, then stir in the cornflour and cool.Line a 23cm pie dish with one pastry sheet and fill with the apples.Lay over the second sheet, crimp the edges, cut steam holes and brush with egg.Bake at 200°C until deep golden and bubbling, then rest 15 minutes.Cut big wedges and serve with thick cream.To ToastConcentrated goodness cherry cola floatsThe amulet of concentrated goodness. Cherry cola over vanilla ice cream.How to make it1.3 L cherry cola500ml vanilla ice cream4 maraschino cherriesPut two scoops of ice cream in each tall glass.Pour the cola slowly down the side so it foams up, then top with a cherry.Root beer from the club eskyMembers only.
